crossRefs.note: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral…
but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be…
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God…

translations.web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
translations.bsb: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.
translations.kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
translations.asv: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.
